# 🚨 Incident Report

## Summary
What happened, when, and how it was detected?

## Severity and scope
Affected files, branches, workflows, accounts, or users.

## Timeline
| Time (UTC) | Event | Evidence |
|---|---|---|

## Impact
Describe confirmed impact separately from possible impact.

## Response
Actions taken, including credential revocation or source rollback.

## Root cause
Explain the contributing conditions.

## Recovery verification
List commands, tests, and review evidence.

## Follow-up actions
| Action | Owner | Priority | Status |
|---|---|---|---|

## Communications
Record who was notified and when, without exposing sensitive details.
